about: TCU Neeley School of Business programs for degree planning. Built 2026-10-17 from the TCU undergraduate catalog (2026-2027, pages unlabeled), Neeley checklists (after summer 2025 and older), and Neeley program pages. Requirement types: all = every course; one = pick one option; hours = pick options until the hours are met. A course fills only one choice requirement per program.

bba_groups.label: Business core (16 hours)
notes: The Neeley checklists list MANA 30250 + MANA 30350; the new four-year plans pair MANA 30250 with MANA 40250 instead. MANA 30350 is not in the TCU course export, and neither MANA 30250 nor MANA 40250 has a section in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027. What does run is MANA 30253 (OB and Strategy, 3 hours, 22 sections), so the plan uses it. An advisor must confirm it satisfies this requirement.

old.label: Started before summer 2025
old.total_hours_conflict: The Neeley Graduation Checklist says 124 hours; the TCU Advising FAQ says 120 for students who began Fall 2021 or later.

bba_groups.label: Business foundation
notes: BUSI 10153 is on the older checklist and the official suggested four-year plans but is not in the current TCU course export. Students who already completed it are fine; anyone who still needs it should ask an advisor what replaces it.

new.label: TCU Core (summer 2025 and later)
rules: A course can count for at most 2 Core categories plus Writing Emphasis.
OCO and WCO courses count only for themselves.
No more than 4 Core requirements (not counting OCO and WCO) from one course prefix.
Writing Emphasis courses must be 30000-40000 level and taken at TCU.

old.label: TCU Core (before summer 2025)
rules: No course fills two Heritage, Mission, Vision & Values categories.
At most 2 courses from one prefix within each group.
Humanities, Social Sciences and Natural Sciences each need at least two different prefixes.
Writing Emphasis can overlap with anything.
